# Lab 13.11: Add Ingress & Egress Rules, Then Enforce

## What We Are Going to Do
Allow your own account into the perimeter with an ingress rule, allow copying to one outside project with an egress rule, then enforce the perimeter.

## Steps

1. **Write an ingress rule.** Create `ingress.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">- ingressFrom:
    identities:
    - user:YOUR_EMAIL
    sources:
    - accessLevel: "*"
  ingressTo:
    operations:
    - serviceName: storage.googleapis.com
      methodSelectors:
      - method: "*"
    resources:
    - "*"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Write an egress rule** to one approved outside project. Create `egress.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">- egressFrom:
    identities:
    - user:YOUR_EMAIL
  egressTo:
    operations:
    - serviceName: storage.googleapis.com
      methodSelectors:
      - method: "*"
    resources:
    - projects/OTHER_PROJECT_NUMBER</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Add both to the dry-run configuration.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-context-manager perimeters dry-run update lab_perimeter \
  --set-ingress-policies=ingress.yaml \
  --set-egress-policies=egress.yaml \
  --policy=$POLICY_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Check the dry-run logs again.** Your own reads no longer show violations. Other users still do.

5. **Enforce the perimeter.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-context-manager perimeters dry-run enforce lab_perimeter --policy=$POLICY_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Test.**
   - As you, from Cloud Shell: `gcloud storage cat gs://$PROJECT_ID-vpcsc/data.txt` works.
   - As Alice, even with **Storage Admin** on the project: the same command fails with `Request is prohibited by organization's policy`.
   - Copying to a bucket in any project other than `OTHER_PROJECT_NUMBER` fails.

7. **Keep it** for the troubleshooting lab.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| You | Allowed by the ingress rule |
| Alice | Blocked, even with IAM roles |
| Egress | Only to the approved project |
| Enforced | Violations now blocked, not only logged |
